The Story Centers on Avalon, the Demon King who has remained undefeated for over 10,000 years, has become bored of his life in his world.
Wanting to feel excitement again, he decides to reincarnate himself into Earth, finding himself in the body of high school student Akari.
Ten years prior, portals to another dimension began appearing, resulting in monsters from dungeons invading Earth, with Hunters being tasked with defeating them.
Akari, who had recently died by suicide over being bullied, has resumed her life, with Avalon using Akari as his way to finally fight the worthy opponents he had long been seeking. Meanwhile, Akari's bullies continue bullying her, unaware of her new powers.
